structural_gate: for every wind separately: centered rank=3 and sigma3/sigma1>=0.05
source_identity_rule: train-only coordinate standardization, two-design-wind source centroids, Euclidean nearest centroid
time_mismatch: shift evaluation minus receiver by 25 samples (5 s), zero-fill prefix
measurement_position_swap: swap evaluation receiver measurements while preserving frozen geometry labels and design prototypes
collapsed_baseline: set evaluation minus trace equal to plus trace
negative_control_gate: every destructive control lowers rank1_count or minimum held-wind margin
ordinary_d2_advantage_rule: signed increment matches or exceeds ORDINARY_D2 held accuracy and strictly exceeds both minimum held margin and worst-wind sigma3/sigma1
